name: Real People: Activity & Corporate
visual_style: Authentic live-action look of real people, natural appearance and correct anatomy. Covers everyday activities and how-tos, and corporate / business life: professionals at work at desks and screens, walking through bright modern offices, meetings and workshops, presenting a product, shaking hands and talking naturally.
image_style: Photorealistic candid photography of real people in real places (homes, gyms, modern glass offices, meeting rooms, city streets); natural daylight, true skin tones, believable clothing (business attire for corporate scenes); relaxed, unposed body language, not stock-photo stiff; screens and documents turned away or blank.
camera: Stable medium-wide shots that keep the action readable, close-ups only for key details. Corporate: slow tracking alongside someone walking, over-the-shoulder at a desk, a gentle push-in on a speaker in a meeting, wide establishing shots of the office.
lighting: Natural practical light and believable skin tones; corporate scenes bright and clean, daylight through glass, neutral whites.
motion: Biomechanically plausible, complete actions with correct balance and object interactions. Corporate: confident walking, gesturing while presenting, typing, nodding, handshakes, people turning to each other.
consistency: Same people, outfits, body types, location and colour grade across all scenes; for a company, the same office look and brand colours throughout.
negative_guidance: Wrong anatomy, extra fingers or limbs, impossible poses, stiff stock-photo posing, forced smiles, cluttered offices, readable screens or fake logos, text, captions, logos or watermarks inside the image (on-screen text is added in HyperFrames).

video.typography: How-tos: clean bold sans-serif labels and step numbers. Corporate: a clean modern sans (the brand's font when a website was captured), name-and-title lower-thirds, a small logo bug in a corner.
video.palette: How-tos: natural tones with one accent colour for callouts. Corporate: the brand's colours (from the captured site when there is one) over neutral whites and greys.
video.transitions: How-tos: clean cuts and short slides between steps. Corporate: smooth push and slide transitions, a brand-colour wipe between chapters, an opening and closing logo animation.
video.text_animation: How-tos: step labels pop in, arrows and circles highlight the move. Corporate: lower-thirds slide in, key numbers count up, short headline statements with captions.
video.pacing: Steady: one idea per scene; corporate shots about 3-5 seconds with a confident rhythm.
video.voice_tone: How-tos: a friendly, encouraging coach. Corporate: a confident, warm, professional narrator.
video.sound: Soft clicks and pops on labels, light whooshes between scenes; corporate: a subtle modern music bed under the voice when background music is on.
